questions.title: SAS Triangle — Find the Missing Side
questions.text: In triangle $ABC$, two sides measure $AB = 3$ and $BC = 4$, and the included angle at $B$ is $90°$. Using the Pythagorean theorem, find the length of the hypotenuse $AC$.
